reviewer: Automated source-grounded review; not independent human annotation or inter-rater validation
scope: All 16 fixed training packet descriptions, ENTITY/PREDICATE annotations, and SEC/ENTITY_REL evidence. No test examples or model-error selection.

decisions.CVE-2023-32629: Local and privilege escalation are supported. Ubuntu Kernels is a product/kernel mention but ORG is coarse. No version or supported named-product/impact relation is fabricated. Product coverage remains incomplete.
decisions.CVE-2024-29291: Laravel Framework 8 through is not a facility. Integer range 8 through 11 is missed. The description explicitly disputes the issue; preserve that wording. Boundary/range and dispute-scope repairs deferred; no automatic facility-to-product span guess.
decisions.CVE-2024-48973: allow an attacker does not identify an attack vector. see 3.2.1 looks like a document section but the reference meaning is not independently established: mark uncertain, retain it pending review, do not assert a corrected software release. unencrypted can be an adjectival/participial predicate; retain.
decisions.CVE-2022-24611: Denial of Service is an impact, not an organization; a correct same-span IMPACT already exists. NodeIDs is not a person but there is no supported replacement subtype in this pass. S0/S2 and product/protocol boundaries remain unresolved. network is actually in the source networking context; retain.
decisions.CVE-2024-24795: allows an attacker is not an access vector. Apache HTTP Server and version 2.4.59 are supported; no same-sentence owner relation exists because the upgrade is in a later paragraph. Do not invent a cross-paragraph link. splitting is nominal in HTTP Response splitting; its repair is deferred because no corroborating typed VULN_TYPE span exists.
decisions.CVE-2021-37851: Windows is software, not a location; ESET Endpoint Antivirus is a product, not a person. Same-span software nodes support suppression of those conflicts. Ordinary system is not a function. Listed HAS_VERSION edges support adjacent mentions only; prior-to bounds and semicolon ownership are incomplete, not proof of affected/fixed status.
decisions.CVE-2021-41773: CVE-2021-42013 is not a person; a same-span CVE_ID exists. path in path normalization is not a predicate. An attacker alone is not a vector. Version edges are mention-only: the source says the 2.4.50 fix was incomplete, so do not infer remediation success. Retain explicit exploitation wording as source evidence, not independent historical evidence.
decisions.CVE-2022-28819: 22.3 is a product version, not a date. write inside the typed out-of-bounds write vulnerability phrase is nominal, not an action predicate. The second version and both and-earlier qualifiers lack complete relation coverage; defer coordination repair.
decisions.CVE-2024-7587: Three 10.97.3 mentions are incorrectly typed DATE despite matching VERSION nodes. Two versions tokens in explicit product-release lists are not action predicates. GENESIS/ICONICS product-version mention edges have source support; all-versions and and-prior qualifiers are not fully represented. DoS as an organization is wrong, but its span differs from the existing IMPACT; defer abbreviation linking.
decisions.CVE-2014-2397: Oracle Java and Java SE Embedded are not people. Embedded inside the product name is nominal. Java 7u51 and integer 8 releases are missed. Existing Java subspans do not justify an automatic larger-span replacement; record and defer these product/version/parser defects.
decisions.CVE-2024-7479: Remote inside TeamViewer Remote Clients names the product, not the attack vector; local in the attacker phrase is valid. Two Windows annotations are wrongly LOC/NORP despite same-span SOFTWARE evidence. Ordinary system is not a function. allows an attacker alone is not a vector. TeamViewer_service.exe is not a person; executable typing and prior-version ownership are deferred.
decisions.CVE-2023-36163: remote attacker is supported. IP-DOT/BuildaGate product boundaries and v.BuildaGate5 release are not represented adequately. Cross Site Scripting is a missed typed vulnerability mention. No generic IP/address rule is added from this example.
decisions.CVE-2024-53937: hardware 1.0 explicitly describes a hardware release, not a software version. allows attackers is not an access vector. Victure router as WORK_OF_ART is wrong; firmware EN_V1.0.0_r12_110933 and LAN/protocol distinctions remain incomplete. Preserve does not require wording; no negation is removed.
decisions.CVE-2018-15473: OpenSSH through 7.7 has an explicit product-version relation with <= operator. CARDINAL 7.7 is a compatible numeric view and is not removed. No automatic repair is warranted by the selected narrow rules; user-enumeration and file mentions remain outside their coverage.
decisions.CVE-2024-54529: macOS product names are incorrectly tagged PERSON, but boundaries overlap multiple existing nodes and versions; defer rather than merge by guesswork. Sequoia/Sonoma/Ventura have mention-only version edges. Missing macOS prefix ownership and fixed-release meaning are unresolved; no edge is relabelled as affected.
decisions.CVE-2024-24747: MinIO and the timestamp-shaped RELEASE identifier are missed by the product/version extraction. Fixed wording exists but does not supply an adjacent named product edge. Preserve unless and denied scope. Adding a distant owner link is deferred.

interpretation: Counts are observations in a bounded development packet, not population extraction precision. Candidate HAS_VERSION is not an affected/fixed or exploitation assertion.

relation_review.CVE-2024-7587: ENTITY_REL e813-e816 use version as an asserted dependency predicate at the two false versions spans. Suppress all four, even when both endpoint entities survive. Retain the independently supported HAS_VERSION mention edges.
relation_review.CVE-2023-36163: ENTITY_REL e177 follows allows a remote attacker to execute. It is a capability statement, not proof execution happened. Keep candidate status; asserted modality is a residual scope limitation, not a verified exploitation event.
relation_review.CVE-2024-53937: ENTITY_REL e470 follows allows attackers to execute. Its source is the unsupported generic ATTACK_VECTOR annotation and is removed with that node. This does not remove the original action wording or IMPACT mention.
relation_review.all_other_relation_rows: The other 24 ENTITY_REL rows are the generic views of the same 24 SEC_HAS_VERSION candidate mentions, not 48 independent facts. No affected/fixed/exploited conclusion is drawn from them.

next_comparison: v5 without subtype features and v5_subtypes, each with node_mean and type_balanced readout, matched seeds/splits/settings. Existing v4 runs retained. No simultaneous regularization change.

regularization_proposal_not_enabled.first: Fixed graphs/model: AdamW weight_decay 0.0001 versus 0.001, same seeds and AP selection; report Brier/log loss separately.
regularization_proposal_not_enabled.second: A separate predeclared AP-selected versus Brier-selected checkpoint study only if calibrated scores are the objective; do not switch criteria after seeing winners.
regularization_proposal_not_enabled.node_penalty: Deferred: LayerNorm already controls per-node scale. A node-norm penalty needs an explicit location/weight and equal-CVE normalization inside deterministic replay, tested against direct gradients.
